govdocs-archive_org-nsia-StLouisPost-Dis: James C. Millstone, assistant managing editor of the St. Louis Post-Dispatch, wrote a letter dated August 18, 1972. The letter survives as a single piece of newspaper correspondence from a senior editor of a major Midwestern daily. It belongs to the paper trail of working journalists in the early 1970s, when letters like this one handled the business that phone calls left unrecorded.
